description: NaV(OF)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form edge-sharing NaOF₅ octahedra. The Na-O bond length is 2.38 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.40 Å. V is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three O and two F atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.92 Å. There is one shorter (1.89 Å) and one longer (1.94 Å) V-F bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent V atoms. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom.
